spawn_spec.prompt:

PREP: the batch manifest exists at /tmp/orca-parity-fix/manifest.json (labels: orca-fix-backend, orca-fix-frontend; workspace /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite). Read it first.
DISPATCH (single invocation, no other helper processes):
  mkdir -p /tmp/orca-parity-fix/reports
  jq -c /tmp/orca-parity-fix/manifest.json | /Users/indo/code/project/omo-bridge/target/release/delegate_to_chatgpt_web --batch-stdin --json
Run it as a background session and rely on the native completion notification (no polling loops, no duplicate watcher processes). Take ONE early peek at the session output to catch an immediate hard-reject (ok:false / invalid_arguments / rate-limit); if hard-rejected, report the verbatim error and stop.
Do NOT pass --browser-driver (discovery is cmux-first with Orca fallback). Do NOT pass --close-on-terminal (IDLE_RETAINED default). Do NOT resume or close any pre-existing scope - this run is a fresh batch by design. Do not spawn a second helper process for any reason, including retries; implementation runs take a long time (an hour or more is normal - do not treat silence as failure).
DELIVERABLE:
1. The helper's complete terminal stdout saved verbatim to /tmp/orca-parity-fix/helper-output.json.
2. Each worker's final summary extracted into /tmp/orca-parity-fix/reports/<label>.md (the terminal JSON carries status; the rich final summaries live in the task-state JSONs under ~/.omo/bridge/task-state/ for the new scopes - locate by matching the new scope ids and copy the final notes/summary content; say so if you did).
3. Final message: per worker - label, scope_id, terminal_state, session_state, and a digest of its summary (per-item status, commits, test counts); plus where the full reports live.
SCOPE: you own only /tmp/orca-parity-fix/**. Never edit repository files; never touch browser tabs or scope files outside the helper contract.
VERIFY: the helper exits 0 and every worker reached ready=true before actual dispatch (visible in early output or ~/.omo/bridge/delegation-lifecycle/ entries for the new scopes); the terminal JSON parses as JSON.
STOP WHEN: the helper's terminal JSON is saved and both worker summaries are extracted, or the helper returns an authoritative terminal error (report it verbatim and stop - do not retry).
